narrative.intro: Humana Government Business has $5.6B in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Humana Government Business received 2 awards so far in the fiscal year, and the average award size is $2.8B. Obligations are down 13.5% year over year. Historical annual obligations show a peak at $8B in FY24 and a decline to $6.5B in FY25 before the FY26 to-date total of $5.6B. The series includes $7.1B in FY21, $7.7B in FY22, and $7.8B in FY23, which places the current fiscal-year pace below the prior four fiscal years. The current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date, and the note clarifies that listed award-value figures in some tables are total contract values while page totals are contract obligations. Readers should treat the FY2026 total as an interim figure rather than a full-year result.
